instruction: Cinematic film still, low-angle medium shot. On top of a concrete wall with graffiti under a clear blue sky, two boys are hanging out. On the left, the boy with a buzz cut (R2) in a light blue tie-dye shirt and dark pants crouches, looking down and laughing with his hand near his mouth. To his right, the boy with braided hair (R1) in a pink and white striped long-sleeve shirt and dark pants sits on the wall's edge, gesturing with his right hand and looking forward. The scene is illuminated by bright, direct sunlight, casting soft shadows against the vibrant blue sky.
elements: R1 sits on the wall's edge and gestures with his right hand
R2 crouches on top of the wall while laughing with his hand near his mouth
R1 looks forward while R2 looks down
a concrete wall with graffiti supports the boys
clear blue sky and bright direct sunlight
